difficulty_reason: The author compares numerical division in matrix products with quotienting by the middle-groupoid action. The complete Lemma16 constructs a nonfree orbit from intersecting conjugate stabilizers and makes its cardinality discrepancy strict; Theorem20 transfers that discrepancy through an arbitrary atomic decomposition. The finite-entry proviso is essential to preserve strictness under the sum. This is the paper explicitly identified independent second main conclusion. The matrix functor theorem, supporting orbit lemmas and linear-logic preservation are not separately counted.
